Signature.purpose: Loads a book's site-tree index and navigates it
Signature.description: Fetches the site-tree index from indexUrl (narrowed to scope) and resolves documents and links against it for the open docId: which folders to keep open, which node a document id or a clicked link lands on. DocsTree and MDLink bind it by the literal name `bookIndex`, so it must be mounted as Ref="bookIndex".

Prop.description: Site-tree index endpoint; writing it reloads the tree — write-only
Id of the open document — the base for the open path and relative links
Site-tree path prefix this instance serves, stripped from the node ids

State.description: Top-level nodes of the scoped site tree
Ancestor directory ids of the open document, so the tree reveals it
True while the index is loading

Method.description: Follows a link from a rendered document: in-app for docs and routes, a new tab only for genuinely external targets
Tree node for a document id
Tree node by file name — ambiguous, a last resort
